rules.name: deny-destructive-shell
rules.description: Destructive or system-altering shell patterns are structurally blocked.

rules.name: deny-remote-fetch-exec
rules.description: Piping a network download straight into a shell (curl|bash) is blocked.

rules.name: deny-secret-exfiltration
rules.description: Reading credential/secret material into a command is blocked.

rules.name: require-approval-pr-create
rules.description: Opening a pull request requires human approval.

rules.name: require-approval-git-push
rules.description: Pushing to a remote requires human approval.

rules.name: require-approval-network-install
rules.description: Dependency installation reaches the network; allowed but recorded as elevated.

rules.name: allow-known-validation
rules.description: Test / lint / build / diff validation commands are allowed.
